_preregistration.primary: is there a T where NLL sits inside the real-text band while novelty stays above the recall baseline? that is structured novelty
_preregistration.null: trajectory goes low-novelty/low-NLL straight to high-novelty/high-NLL -- the construction recombines or randomises. A perfectly good result
_preregistration.overclaim_boundary: a positive result means the construction produces sequences that are unseen and predictable to an INDEPENDENT model. It does NOT mean the model has new ideas. Novel n-grams are not ideas and semantic novelty is not measured here
_preregistration.why_r_ge_3: F69: the degeneracy occupies r in {1,2}; measuring creativity there would repeat F62-F66's mistake
_preregistration.why_external_scorer: scoring output with its own generator is near-circular
_preregistration.why_roundtrip: real text is encoded/decoded through the GENERATOR's tokenizer so its formatting artifacts appear in the reference and cancel
